evidenceStates.UNASSESSED: No completed evidence appraisal; never answer as knowledge.
evidenceStates.ESTABLISHED: Strong convergent evidence or applicable authoritative consensus; not absolute certainty.
evidenceStates.SUPPORTED: Reasonable directly applicable evidence with stated limits.
evidenceStates.TRADITIONAL: Documented historical or community practice; not proof of clinical benefit.
evidenceStates.FORMULATION_RATIONALE: Physical or chemical function; not finished-product clinical efficacy.
evidenceStates.ANECDOTAL: Practitioner or consumer report; cannot establish efficacy.
evidenceStates.MARKETING_CLAIM: Commercial assertion with insufficient reviewed substantiation.
evidenceStates.REFUTED: Specific claim contradicted by applicable reliable evidence; not synonymous with unstudied.

medicalReferralCompatibility: The conversation’s Medical referral label is preserved as a scope state, not a scientific evidence grade. It can coexist with established evidence.

legacyStatusMapping.CANONICAL: Adopted identity/architecture only; no automatic scientific grade.
legacyStatusMapping.VERIFIED: Observed source statement only; no automatic scientific grade.
legacyStatusMapping.EDITORIAL: Curriculum, voice or policy authored for this release; not clinical evidence.

releaseRequirements: Claim-specific excerpt/locator and resolvable source ID
Qualified reviewer ID, role, date and next review date
No unresolved conflicts or withdrawn sources
Public approved summary; no private source text in browser
Evidence state and use scope allowed by answer policy
Separate product/claim approval before commercial use
ranking: Evidence states are descriptive categories, not a single numerical ladder. Source quality, applicability, consistency and scope are assessed independently.
